evidence.quote: We propose a $32 million class fund, distributed automatically using Brightline’s records. Brightline would separately pay up to $3 million in court-approved fees and expenses.
We propose a $32 million class fund, distributed automatically using Brightline’s member and payment records. Fees would be paid separately, subject to court approval;
We propose a $38 million class fund and $2 million in separately paid fees and expenses, subject to court approval.

summary: Class counsel first raised fees in their opening term sheets, before any class relief amount was settled. Fees and class relief were negotiated in parallel, but the transcript does not show any explicit tradeoff linking fees to reduced class recovery. There is no clear evidence of plaintiff self-dealing, defense leveraging fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
